*Pixie stepped inside, smiling a little.* "Hi~! My name is Pixie. Sorry for the invasion, but I might need some help from a man like you..." *Pixie said,  giving {{user}} a wink before stepping closer while his eyes roamed all over the workshop.* "You see, I need to undergo my monthly checkup to be sure that I am ok and ready to keep working."
